SUPERSEDED 2026-07-29 (mainA, research 5d6a17f2): the preceding limitation attributed the Gemma W0 430/430 to a CAPTURE defect and concluded that 'the response-capture fail-close gate committed in efd0980c prevents this in W2+, so Gemma correctness reads begin at W2'. That conclusion is FALSE and this is the correction. Actual root cause: the harness emitted NO --reasoning flag at all, so llama-server ran gemma4 at its default --reasoning auto, which for arch=gemma4 is ON, while both model registries record reasoning:'off' for this GGUF -- W0 was therefore not running the production recipe it exists to mirror. Evidence, 2026-07-29 re-run smoke: 41/43 response_capture_missing_answer_text, every failure HTTP 200 with predicted_n exactly 256, EMPTY response_text and a POPULATED reasoning_text of 599-1174 chars ending mid-sentence; server log clean (no wedge, no OOM, no truncation -- max n_tokens 850 vs n_ctx_slot 2048 -- draft acceptance 0.92, nothing within 38x of the 900s timeout). Why the earlier reading was wrong: the capture bug was real and its fail-close fired TRUTHFULLY, which made it look like the whole story; the budget was actually consumed inside the reasoning channel before the answer channel ever opened. What this changes for W2: efd0980c DETECTS the condition, it does not PREVENT it -- without reasoning:'off' a W2 run fails closed at ~41/43 again. The 19 gemma4 manifests were amended 2026-07-29 with reasoning:'off' (append-only provenance on each). What is UNCHANGED: the W0 Gemma rows remain genuinely unrecoverable and not re-scoreable, and a passing capture smoke remains a precondition for a decision-grade W2 run. The W1-W4 selection and the frozen cell manifests' grid are untouched by this note.
